title: The tallest tree
text:
Rafi wanted to climb the tallest tree in the park. His friend Lin said, "It is too high."

Rafi tried anyway. He climbed one branch. Then he climbed a second. But his legs began to shake, and he looked down. The ground was far away.

"I want to go back," he said in a small voice.

"Take a deep breath," said Lin. "Come down one branch at a time."

Rafi came down slowly. When his feet touched the grass, he smiled. "Next time, I will start with a smaller tree," he said.

Lin laughed. "That is a good plan!"
